mentions.name: Archiver for pre-compressed files
mentions.description: A new kind of file archiver that specializes in compressing files that are already internally compressed as part of their specification. It is one of three apps built with a Zig core, C FFI, and Windows/Mac frontends.
mentions.source_excerpt: The third is a new kind of archiver that specializes in compressing files that are already internally compressed as part of their spec.
